voice:
In a moment, you rise for one breath... and then drop right back down — twice as deep as before.
Up... just for a breath.
Sissy Drops.
All the way down, deeper than before. Even deeper now. So easy, so natural. Falling so far for me, so fast. Down, down — further than you've ever gone. Sinking for me, deeper with every breath.
Each fall is easier than the last... and each drop carries you deeper than the one before.
That's it. You are doing perfectly... deeper and deeper still.
